description: Oil leak dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Matteo Cardoni. This dataset is a collection of 3D rendering generated images modelling the junction between the high speed shaft and the external bracket of the power generator inside a wind turbine, in presence and absence of oil leaks. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
